reasons: The three images successfully fulfill distinct functional roles without being near-duplicates.
Image 1 (Role 1) serves as a crop-identity overview, showing dense, long-onion rows to establish the 'Mosir' (chili) context, even though the crop is botanically neutral/wide-leaf.

Image 2 (Role 2) acts as the agronomic close evidence, providing a tighter shot that includes specific irrigation lines (drip tape) and young vegetable rows, supporting the 'irrigation principles' aspect of the article.

Image 3 (Role 3) tells the irrigation-system story, featuring a broader landscape with agricultural machinery (tractors) in the background, differentiating it significantly from the first two images in terms of layout and narrative.
All images remain true to the 'zero people' constraint.
